description: The website motion tier and the hero demo: motion tokens (tokens.json, gen-tokens, tokens.css), motion.ts + SiteMotion island + the inline boot script, the motion CSS A1-A5 in site.css and the A6 cross-fade in globals.css, the full KeypadDemo (observer, once-only autoplay, Stop, announce, Hear it via lib/speech), the motion steering text, and the unit tests. Depends on FEAT-002 (markup, data-reveal blocks, KeypadPicture).
steps: Plan step 16: add the motion group (11 tokens with usage text, design.md 'Tokens' table) to design/system/tokens.json; add 'motion' to the loop at packages/web/scripts/gen-tokens.mjs line 79; run `pnpm -F @ninth/web tokens`; add an MS-8.2 case to test/tokens.test.ts; add the 'Website' paragraph to design/system/README.md Motion.

Plan step 17: new components/site/motion.ts (SITE_MOTION_BOOT exactly as design.md Gating 1, msToken, autoplayDecision, splitInitialReveal, ARRIVAL_FALLBACK_MS = 1200) and components/site/SiteMotion.tsx ('use client', renders null, behaviour of design.md Gating 2); app/page.tsx renders <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: SITE_MOTION_BOOT }} /> as the first child of .site and <SiteMotion /> last; new test/site-motion.test.tsx; MS-8.1 raw boot-script case in test/site.test.tsx.

Plan step 19: KeypadDemo.tsx per design.md 'KeypadDemo changes' (observer thresholds [0, 0.1, 0.6], autoplay once via autoplayDecision, acted/autoplayed refs, stop() to the finished frame on Stop / ratio < 0.1 / hidden page / reduce change, three labels with hidden sizers, sentence/digits/chip sizers, announce only after a person's play, Hear it via speak + pickVoice with lang 'en', shown after speechSupported() in useEffect and disabled while playing, msToken timings with DEMO_STEP_FALLBACK_MS 520 and AUTOPLAY_DELAY_FALLBACK_MS 1200, visually hidden caption from content.md §1); new test/keypad-demo.test.tsx (MS-6.2-6.9 cases of the Test plan).

acceptance_criteria: `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run` passes including tokens.test.ts (committed tokens.css equals generator output), site-motion.test.tsx, keypad-demo.test.tsx, site-css.test.ts and site.test.tsx

findings: Verification (this checkout, dev server on :3000, nothing committed): `pnpm -F @ninth/web tokens` wrote styles/tokens.css (11 --motion-* on :root); `pnpm -r typecheck` pass; `pnpm -F @ninth/web test --run` pass (29 files, 323 tests; new site-motion.test.tsx 16, keypad-demo.test.tsx 18; site-css.test.ts now 19; tokens.test.ts 6; site.test.tsx 32); tm-lint clean on all 20 changed files; validate-kiro-config ok (10 hooks); check-kiro-not-ignored ok; curl /app 200; `BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 node test/e2e/axe.mjs` 'all checks passed' (landing / 0 violations, 29 rules, Night+Day, 1280+390). Playwright MCP by hand on the dev server: 1280x900 motion on, the demo read 'Stop' 1.43 s after navigation start and 'Play the example again' at 7.2 s; it did not play again; on a fresh load Stop during the autoplay showed 'I need water'; the .site-demo box stayed 400x686 during the whole play; layout-shift sum 0.0017 after load (likely the Hear it button appearing after mount, which the design accepts); the proof frames read opacity 1,0,0 at the start of their pass and 0,0,1 at the end; the scan rings showed one ring at a time in order (1000, 0100, 0010, 0001). 390x844 motion on: a below-the-fold access card had opacity 0 before scrolling and 1 (data-revealed=1) 1.2 s after; after scrolling to the end no time-based animation was running (17 scroll-driven ones attached, as expected); emulating reduce then removed data-site-motion and emptied getAnimations(). Reduced motion from load: no data-site-motion, 0 of 36 [data-reveal] blocks under opacity 1, getAnimations() empty, no autoplay. No console errors or warnings on the current build (earlier 'SITE_MOTION_BOOT is not defined' entries in .playwright-mcp logs came from an HMR reload in the middle of the edit). Notes for later steps: (1) The visible button label is span.site-demo__label; the button also holds three aria-hidden sizer copies (all labels), so its textContent is not the label: e2e should read `.site-demo__label` or use getByRole('button', { name: 'Stop' }) (accessible name excludes the aria-hidden copies). (2) Sizers: `.site-sizer` grid wrappers hold the live `.site-demo__text` / `.site-demo__keys` first and an aria-hidden `.site-sizer__ghost` copy second; the ghost chip list is `ul.site-demo__chips-ghost` (not `.site-demo__chips`, so chip counts on `.site-demo__chips` still see 3). (3) The button reads 'Play the example again' after any play has ended, stopped or finished. (4) Deviation, written into design.md A5: the scan rings have different boxes, so they use a named timeline `--site-scan` on `.site-scan` instead of view() (otherwise two rings could show at once); desktop How frames use `--site-how` as designed. All timeline rules carry the `[data-site-motion]` prefix, including timeline-scope/view-timeline. (5) The motion block sits before the short-landscape @media, which stays last. The ninth-key visibility rule stayed in the static part (FEAT-002 note 5), not duplicated. (6) KeypadDemo exports DEMO_STEP_FALLBACK_MS and AUTOPLAY_DELAY_FALLBACK_MS; motion.ts also exports MOTION_QUERY and readMotionMs(name, fallback) (reads :root, browser only, wrapped in try). (7) SiteMotion sets data-site-arrived as an empty attribute. (8) Steering: accessibility.md rule 5 and design-system.md 'Spooky, but calm' updated; tasks.md task 22 stays unticked because tech.md and the accessibility.md 'How to check' line belong to FEAT-004 step 26. Ticked tasks 2, 2.1, 14, 14.1, 15, 15.1, 16, 16.1 (now 'MS-6.2-6.10'), 23. KIRO_LOG row added (2026-11-10, 'Kiro (marketing-landing workflow, FEAT-003)'). (9) The shell tool often times out while the command still finishes; run commands with nohup and logs in /tmp.
